A third Main restored the original DP automatically and returned the application resource.

deploymentRegistryPublication.scope: The file-size limit was applied only to non-root JVMs using synthetic registry paths. Two independent JVMs loaded the helper from the two actual installed bundles. The packaged Main separately restored the prior DP with its original registry and archive.
